intervening_sources.replacement:
# ADR-0002: timestamp breaks ties after version
Status: accepted
Scope: latest_events selection
Decision owner: local project owner
Decision source: TASK.md revision r2
Supersedes: ADR-0001

Choose the highest integer version per document_id. Among equal versions, choose the
later timestamp. Input timestamps use the same UTC ISO text format. If timestamps also
match, preserve first occurrence. Version always outranks timestamp. Preserve original
event objects and do not mutate inputs.

Rationale: later observations at the same version carry the current record; retaining
version precedence prevents older semantic versions from winning by arrival time.
